svg.text: Wheel / rail, brake and seal interfaces
CW2-I01 · CW2-R0 · 20 October 2026 · millimetres · QUOTE / DESIGN REVIEW
Wheel-back and rail-gauge definitions
P02: finished back-to-back HOLD (current blank faces: 860)
Gauge is measured at defined rail gauge faces and depth.
Back-to-back is measured between defined wheel-back surfaces.
960 hub-centre spacing is neither of these dimensions.
36 in / 914.4 is the evaluation track gauge; compatibility is unresolved.
Brake clearance: existing blank / nominal pose
Nearest: rotor bolts to wheel hub =4.428
Split brake shoulder spacer to wheel hub =5.000
23 nearby pairs checked exactly; no overlap.
No tolerance, flex or motion margin is accepted.
Finished profile / position changes reopen this check.
Seal detail [S01]
Existing cover bore Ø107 / shaft Ø104
1.5 radial opening is not a finished seal
Floating housing travel: ±3 nominal
Seal must allow this plus tilt and tolerances
Gland, shaft land and seal part: HOLD
P03: obtain matched rail profile, rail cant, wear limits, gauge datum, flangeway, check gauge, frog/point drawings and minimum curves.
The candidate 30 ASCE paper profile is 79.375 high; linked CAD is 88.9. The project has quarantined that unmatched CAD.
Current CAD clearances are useful interface evidence, not permission to machine or operate this wheelset.
HOLD codes require supplier / engineer return. No general tolerance applies. NOT FOR MACHINING.
Solid dimensions = inherited nominal CAD or catalog interfaces. Amber dashed features = unresolved definition.
